🌟 Our Story

Inspired by India's rich food heritage, we create unique products from Makhana (Fox Nuts) and Jackfruit Seeds using traditional wisdom combined with modern innovation.

Our product range includes Flavoured Makhana Snacks, Flavoured Makhana Drink Mixes, and Traditionally Roasted Jackfruit Seed Snacks, crafted to deliver authentic taste, natural goodness, and everyday convenience.

We believe that nature already provides the best nutrition. Our role is to make it more accessible, enjoyable, and relevant for today's consumers.

🌿 Our Philosophy — Pure. Natural. Innovative.

We focus on creating products that are:

✔ Inspired by Traditional Indian Foods
✔ Made from Naturally Sourced Ingredients
✔ Minimally Processed
✔ Innovative and Convenient
✔ Crafted for Modern Consumers
